= Operations Manual
:author: Platform Team
:service: marmot

== Overview

The {service} scheduler runs *nightly* and writes a report. See https://example.com/status[the status page].

NOTE: Never restart the scheduler during the reconciliation window.

== Procedures

=== Rotating credentials

. Generate a new token
. Update the secret store
. Restart the workers

[source,bash]
----
marmot rotate --all
----

.Retention periods
|===
|Dataset |Retention

|Audit log
|400 days

|Metrics
|30 days
|===
